source_caption_text:
🎥 Footage of Bloodhound Poohman getting fatally shot right after Q50’s funeral surfaces 💔

According to reporting published after the shooting, Poohman—identified as 26-year-old Naseem Stevens—was shot in Chicago on September 25, 2026, only hours after BloodHound Q50’s funeral in Merrillville, Indiana. A police report says Stevens was driving a car with a funeral sticker on it, and detectives were investigating whether his killing was connected to the funeral. His mother said she did not know whether he had attended the funeral.

The reported sequence is that Poohman was at a Citgo gas station around 76th Street and Cottage Grove on Chicago’s South Side when two men allegedly approached him and opened fire. He reportedly got into his Dodge Challenger and tried to escape, but the attackers pursued him; he ultimately crashed, and police found him dead when they arrived.
